purpose: Provenance for the PAINTED whole-body pictures: <id>_walk_side (side view, faces right) replaces walk/<id>_walk_side.png for the Basecamp walker; <id>_idle_front (optional) is a standing front pose: Click at the lodge door, and the starter on the Choose Your Buddy hero card. Verified by tests/integration/basecamp-painted-assets.test.ts and the client bundle scan. Refresh after adding or replacing a picture: node tests/scripts/refresh-painted-provenance.mjs
source: OpenArt nano-banana-2 image2image, owner-approved selection on November 7, 2026
storage: normal Git blobs (no Git LFS rule matches the runtime directory)
facing: right (the game flips horizontally to walk left)
